profile.description: PZTestKit + the staged NutritionRevamp copy at 457f39f with x231's P1+P3 instruments, fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, sleep on, build 42.21.0 - the harness self-check, idle frames and the slow minute by step.

meta.bench_note: Every reading here is cost, not behaviour, except the self-check and the clock: phase A is x231's phase A on 42.21, read beside #3387 and #3346. No behaviour row rests on this session.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: every per-run cost is a total over many runs divided by their count, and is stated with its count and its ms total.
meta.call_counter_note: the Java-call counter counts NR.call (and NR.num/obj/flag, which call it by table lookup); direct colon calls are not counted at run time.
